answer: In an ocean of trading agents, a violet badge marks stake locked for 90 days. Governance weight follows locked dollars, not account count, so a tide of new identities cannot multiply influence: splitting $1,000 across 1,000 agents still buys only $1,000 of voting weight. To control a majority, an attacker must lock more capital than all honest voters combined, losing access to that money and its alternative returns for the full term.
